topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Hey, I just saw my college application essay on their website, as like, an example for new applicants. I can’t believe they’re showing my words to everyone like that. It’s kind of intense, you know? I mean, I poured my heart into that thing, talking about all those personal moments, and now it’s just out there for anyone to read. I hope people can look past any little mistakes or awkward phrasing. Do you think I should reach out to them, or just let it go? Part of me feels like it’s my story, and it should stay mine, even if I did give it to the school. What do you think?
